title: viola canina subsp. elatior
intro: Viola canina subsp. elatior, commonly known as the tall dog violet, is a plant species belonging to the violet family (Violaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including the treatment of digestive issues, coughs, and sore throats, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects. The therapeutic actions of Viola canina subsp. elatior are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents responsible for its properties include glycosides, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
